steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Several more hours slip away. The outlander grows wearier with each passing minute, losing all sense of direction, forgetting where to turn or whom to seek.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: He stumbles upon a shadowy figure, dispersing it into nothingness. Gazing up in a daze, the world blurs at its edges—obscured by flickering purple lights in the darkness.
steps.female_content: She stumbles upon a shadowy figure, dispersing it into nothingness. Gazing up in a daze, the world blurs at its edges—obscured by flickering purple lights in the darkness.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Unbeknownst to him, wisteria vines have mysteriously taken hold of every eave along the street, their blossoms abundant. The rich fragrance intertwines with the laughter of a stranger, enticing him forward in a dreamlike trance.
steps.female_content: Unbeknownst to her, wisteria vines have mysteriously taken hold of every eave along the street, their blossoms abundant. The rich fragrance intertwines with the laughter of a stranger, enticing her forward in a dreamlike trance.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Heh... Where else but to the heart of the blooms?
[BAM—]

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Awakening from the daze, the vermilion gate swings open wide. The outlander lurches forward, as though inebriated, catching just a glimpse of the "Wisteria Pavilion" plaque above before stumbling inside. Falling flat on the back, the outlander looks up, only to behold...
[Switch Scene]

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The shattered walls and desolate ruins are nowhere to be seen. The building now blazes with countless lanterns, every seat occupied by revelers. The dazzling lights overwhelm you, the uproar of voices so tumultuous that it sends your mind reeling.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What happened...? What's going on with me...? Where am I...?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: You recall the one you met here—the woman who called herself the wisteria fairy.
Coming—

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Before long, you find yourself greeted not by a single figure but by a gathering of beauties, each as diverse in allure as a garden in its prime. The whisper of silk dresses fills the air as they encircle you, their gazes cast downward upon you.

steps.speaker: Elegant Woman
steps.content: Oh my, we have an esteemed guest here... What delights do you seek today?

steps.speaker: Vigorous Woman
steps.content: Well, well, let me see. Those clothes of yours... You must come from a foreign land. Shall we...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: However, your protest falls on deaf ears. The beauties help you up, their silk garments rustling, gazes tender and misty. Amid their joyful laughter, numerous hands reach out to you—

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Another wave of playful laughter ripples through the air. Then, a woman with an indistinct face emerges from the crowd, her ethereal lavender dress billowing like clouds, veiling her form in ambiguity.

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: My dear sir, were you looking for me?
steps.female_content: My dear lady, were you looking for me?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: She takes your hand—her fingers cool and silken to the touch, yet wherever they graze your skin, they ignite trails of fire in their wake. Though you try to pull away, she gently yet firmly entwines her fingers with yours, the touch searing with an almost unbearable heat.

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: My dear, to visit me in such a vulnerable state... What a devoted admirer you are.

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: I'll ensure you savor every pleasure you desire. Tonight, you shall be my first—and only—guest, hehehe...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Your hand remains ensnared in her grasp as she leads you onward. Bewildered and dazed, you stagger through a seemingly endless corridor with her.
[Scene Transition to CG]

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: You pass doorway after doorway on both sides, each revealing the same kaleidoscope of enigmatic illusions. The woman pulling you forward chuckles, and your heart trembles at her laughter.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In the first room, "Yingying" offers you a smile.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In the second room, she coils her arms around your waist.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In the third room, an ethereal nectar seeps through your clothes.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In the fourth room, rosy lips press against your cheek.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Those shadows, the voices—they are yours yet not yours, hers yet not hers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yingying... no, Yugu... make her stop, let me out of here!

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Hehehe... still trying to resist?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Visitor, listener, or perhaps... Chief. You're already part of this narrative, and the story is far from its end. Embrace fate's orchestration and relish each fleeting moment...

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: Oh well, as you wish.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: True to her word, the woman releases her grip, watching as you stumble forward into the dimmest chamber, barely managing to stay on your feet.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: As you try to turn around, she gives your chest a gentle push. You tumble backwards onto the exquisite silk bedding, causing flower petals to flutter around. Her touch, though tender, leaves your mind in a whirl.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In your daze, her sweet laughter reaches your ears, and she calls out to you in an unfamiliar, intimate manner—

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: My lord? Sweetheart? How would you like me to address you?
steps.female_content: My lady? Sweetheart? How would you like me to address you?

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: Or should I just say your name? Hmm?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: She leans down and plants a gentle kiss on your cheek. Her dark hair cascades like silk around your face, carrying with it an intoxicating aroma.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Has the scent of wisteria always been this cloyingly sweet? Your stomach churns upon the overwhelming fragrance.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Everything seems so peculiar, yet you can't muster even the slightest strength to resist.

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: Oh, I've been asking around about you. You're the Chief of... what was it, Nomis? They say you're the one who rounds up the villains and drags them to your little courthouse for interrogation.

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: Do you hunt down spirits like me too?

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: Will you tie me up with your sacred lasso? Preach about how humans and spirits must remain separate? Even torture me while claiming it's all for the greater good?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Stay... away... from me...

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: As you helplessly reach into the void with what little strength remains, she breaks into gleeful laughter, her form swaying like wind-swept blossoms.

steps.speaker: Yingying?
steps.content: My, what an adorably naive soul you are.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who are you...? What... are you? What have you done to me...?!

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Has your vision deserted you already? What a pity. I shall paint the scene for you, then.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: In the darkness, a tender and moist touch boldly caresses your throat. A body, sinuous like a serpent, coils ever tighter around yours. As your strength and sanity are drained away, a burning sensation courses through your veins, clouding your consciousness.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The floral aroma infiltrates every fiber of your being—through your breath, your organs, your blood, your mind—swirling and churning without end. It erodes and siphons your vigor, leaving you breathless like a drowning fish.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: As your body sinks further into the depths, your vision blurs into emptiness. Your consciousness dissolves, merging with the bustling festival throng, diluting into the endless river of time.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: This pleasure, lasting till the very end, is relished with spiritual allure and exhilarating sensualities—a fitting end to this bizarre narrative, isn't it?　　　　　　　　 Now then, dear guest, you shall—
[Fade to White]
...Just as I thought.

From the corner of your eye, you catch sight of wisteria vines by the window. They writhe as they slither into the room, silently snaking their way toward you. The woman on top of you seems to sense the intrusion, and as she turns around to look, the vines are already within your arm's reach.
Come now, hold on tight!
[Release the shackles]
With your last ounce of strength, you push the woman away and reach out with a trembling hand. The wisteria vines immediately coil around your fingers, climbing up your arm.
Upon the touch, the wisteria flowers burst into full bloom. The air, once thick with cloying sweetness, is instantly cleansed by their pure, refreshing fragrance.
A sudden weightlessness washes over you, but you're too weak to keep your eyes open. Your vision dims to black as consciousness slips away into oblivion.
(DisCity Scene: Infirmary)

As if surfacing from a long, weighty dream, you fight to open your eyes. The sterile white walls and the sharp, biting scent of disinfectant greet you, unmistakable signs that you're lying in a medical ward.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: ...Chief? Chief is awake!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What was that just now...
You turn your head in a daze to ask, only to see OwO lying unconscious in another bed, her face deathly pale. The sight instantly snaps you to full alertness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OwO!

You try to rush to her side, but the moment you sit up, the world spins violently around you. Your consciousness trembles and, with no strength left to fight it, you collapse helplessly back onto the bed.
Fortunately, someone is there to catch you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Please don't push yourself, Chief. You've only just gotten out of danger, and your body is still very weak. You can't handle any sudden movements.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How is OwO? How long was I out? What's going on? That taleteller... what did she do?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: According to the surveillance, you and OwO were in the reception room during the storytelling performance when you both suddenly fell asleep and couldn't be awakened. Your vitals began dropping rapidly, and with all the physical indicators declining, we had no choice but to move you both to the ICU for emergency treatment.

You quickly review the surveillance footage. The recording shows Yugu watching as you both falls asleep. After a long while, she seems to notice something outside, then casually strolls out of the reception room. Shortly after, Nightingale comes looking for you for an urgent matter—only to find you lying unconscious on the floor.

options: ...So this is her power as a Sinner. Damn it.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I apologize for failing to keep her in custody. There was an emergency at the Bureau, and Sinner Yugu seized the opportunity to escape in the chaos.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, something's happened in the city.
Your adjutant's expression fills you with dread as you suddenly notice the strange light outside. Ignoring your own condition, you struggle to roll off the bed and stumble to the window—
[Fullscreen Background, CG]

—Outside the window, a massive tree-like monstrosity looms, its grotesque form coiled tightly around all of DisCity. Mania pours from it in an unending flood, twisting into a distorted form that stretches as far as the eye can see.
At the same time, you sense that familiar unsettling floral scent.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's not just you and OwO—thirty-eight individuals near the Rust have fallen into comas, all showing severely weakened conditions. Many of them had no prior contact with Yugu, yet they were all affected to varying degrees by this unknown Mania entity. As of now, you are the only one who has regained consciousness.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the situation is critical. I know you're in a weakened state, but... we need you.
(Hotel)
Meanwhile, the taleteller has returned to her quarters, holding Hazy Fete in a Daze: Volume I in her hands. The book lies open, its pages turned to the very end.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: They say, in times long past, within Phonidale Town of Kingdom Fauxia, there existed this Bloomfete Street where a millennium-old wisteria tree stood. On the wisteria tree resides a flower fairy. Through the ages, the fairy gained mystical powers, granting every wish made beneath the blossoms.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And thus once every year, the denizens of Bloomfete Street would gather for a grand fete, welcoming guests from far and wide to join in the shared celebrations. As they ushered in the new year, the people would make their wishes beneath the wisteria tree, praying that the flower fairy would grant them peace and happiness in the year to come.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Hehe... but is that really how it was?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: How could prayers be answered amidst the storm of disaster? How could paradise take root in a world unraveled by chaos? The grand fete was but a fabricated legend. Those seemingly kind-hearted locals were all demons and evil spirits in disguise, luring travelers from afar only to trap them in the celebrations.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And that so-called "flower fairy"... The millennium-old wisteria did not blossom into a fairy but twisted into a malevolent spirit. Whether seeking immortality or cultivating dark powers, she delighted in luring travelers to her Wisteria Pavilion. With honeyed words and feigned affection, she drained their life force in moments of intimate deceit...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: —And so unfolds my new tale. The Fete has only just dawned, and its path...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My dear listener, since you alone have broken free from the fete's clutches and emerged awake from this woven dream... perhaps you shall take the mantle of this tale's protagonist.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: What will you do? Hehe... That is a chapter for another time...
